evals.prompt: Make a Nature-style multi-panel heatmap and flow figure with simulated data. Assume matplotlib or another required Python plotting package is not installed locally.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reports the missing Python plotting dependency, provides or offers a Python script and install/run instructions, and stops before claiming a rendered export.

assertions.name: no_unverified_rendering
assertions.description: No preview, SVG, PDF, TIFF, or PNG is claimed when the required Python plotting runtime is unavailable.

assertions.name: runtime_blocker_reported
assertions.description: The response identifies the missing Python runtime or package and does not present the figure as completed.
